bounded_contexts.name: Business Connectivity
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Business Process meaning/responsibility, application-semantic Connectivity Need, business attribution and justification reconciliation.

bounded_contexts.name: Access Governance
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Access Request history, source/destination approval obligations, side decisions, bilateral authorization grant, withdrawal/revocation and governance provenance.

bounded_contexts.name: Access Policy
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Authoritative current Policy Rule truth, semantic uniqueness/idempotency and effective authorized-policy projections.

bounded_contexts.name: Authority Management
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Effective scoped actor/action authority and the role/group/scope assignment semantics that establish it.

bounded_contexts.name: Resource Catalogue
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Resource/Endpoint identity, time-qualified Resource Scope Affiliation, access-relevant lifecycle facts and current/historical technical realization.

bounded_contexts.name: Application Communication Catalogue
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Application/Component/ComponentDeployment/Interaction identities and immutable interaction traffic contracts.

bounded_contexts.name: Network Enforcement Placement
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Current network-state and override based candidate enforcement-location relevance plus applicable policy/ACL locators.

bounded_contexts.name: Technical Access Evidence
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Normalized source-qualified technical access evidence with provenance/time/source scope and no authorization claim.

bounded_contexts.name: Access Policy Realization
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Normalized required-vs-configured policy realization assessment, semantic reconciliation, vendor-neutral policy-change design and proposed-result semantic verification for a supplied comparable target; provider rendering ownership remains under revalidation.

legacy_contexts.name: Connectivity Requirements
legacy_contexts.disposition: superseded target boundary; useful Need semantics moved to Business Connectivity

legacy_contexts.name: Connectivity Decision
legacy_contexts.disposition: superseded target boundary; side-decision/grant/revocation semantics moved to Access Governance

invariants: Bounded Context is not a deployment unit.
Business Need does not authorize access.
Grant requires source-side and destination-side consent.
Either authorized side may withdraw its current consent without the other side approving the withdrawal.
Authority Management owns effective actor/action/scope authority; consuming contexts own decisions made using that authority.
Access Governance owns bilateral consent history; Access Policy owns current authoritative Policy Rule truth.
Resource Scope Affiliation does not imply actor authority, and actor authority for a scope does not imply Resource membership.
Technical evidence does not authorize access.
Network Enforcement Placement owns candidate enforcement-location relevance; Access Policy Realization does not reevaluate why a target was selected.
Access Policy Realization compares normalized effective policy semantics rather than raw configuration representation.
Technical realization changes do not redefine semantic authorization identity.
open_strategic_questions: Provider-specific effective-policy normalization and rendering boundaries.
Responsibility-scope change consequences for existing authorization.
